verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs assert 'legendary power efficiency' and faster rendering/exports, but there are no documented power envelope figures (watts/TDP) and no independent sustained-load or thermal-throttling benchmarks in the pack; community comments even question the validity of Apple's efficiency comparisons (comm-6), though this is skepticism about methodology rather than a concrete throttling failure. missing for 10: documented wattage/power envelope specs, independent long-render/export throttling benchmarks, third-party performance-per-watt testing.
